name: White Collar
description: In exchange for his freedom, charming con artist Neal Caffrey provides his expertise to help straight-man FBI agent Peter Burke catch elusive white-collar criminals.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: When the trail of elusive criminal "The Dutchman" dead ends, FBI Agent Peter Burke teams up with a most unlikely partner to catch him - the imprisoned Neal Caffrey.

videos.title: Threads
videos.overview: Neal and Peter infiltrate New York's Fashion Week to stop a security data which is woven in the fabric of a model's dress, from being sold by a criminal.

videos.title: Book of Hours
videos.overview: The disappearance of a precious bible creates an interesting union when a New York Mafia kingpin enlists the help of Peter and the FBI in tracking down his beloved artifact. But while rooting out the thief, Neal finds himself in a tango with a sexy female villain and must decide where his loyalty truly lies.

videos.title: Flip of the Coin
videos.overview: Peter thinks he's in for it when Elizabeth shows up at the office with her friend Dana in tow. But Peter isn't the one in trouble this time; it's Dana's husband, Captain John Mitchell, who is in the hot seat.

videos.title: The Portrait
videos.overview: When an expensive portrait is stolen from a young woman, Peter and Neal set a sting for the cunning and deadly culprit. Neal must uncover the secret truth of the portrait's origin even as the net tightens around the villain ... and around Neal himself!

videos.title: All In
videos.overview: Thrust into the seedy underbelly of New York's Chinatown, Peter and Neal must navigate vicious Triads, mysterious Interpol agents, and a game of Pai Gow in order to capture their target.

videos.title: Free Fall
videos.overview: The FBI investigates a spectacular jewelry heist and all the clues point to Neal. Now Peter must figure out if his "partner" is telling the truth or if Neal is pulling a con of his own.

videos.title: Hard Sell
videos.overview: Neal must infiltrate a company of corrupt Wall Street brokers to preserve his deal with the FBI. When Peter is forced to go undercover alongside him, a discovery is made that could change their partnership forever.

videos.title: Bad Judgment
videos.overview: When Peter and Neal discover that an estate judge committing mortgage fraud is also connected to Fowler, they devise a plan to bring them both down.

videos.title: Vital Signs
videos.overview: When June's granddaughter suffers renal trauma, Neal stumbles upon a cruel scheme to harvest human organs and brings the case to Peter.

videos.title: Home Invasion
videos.overview: To avoid an international conflict, Peter and Neal have to find a thief who is stealing pieces to a valuable collection.

videos.title: Bottlenecked
videos.overview: An old rival of Neal's lays down a challenge: to see if either of them can create an impossible forgery. But as the rival uses brutal and deadly tactics to achieve his ends, Neal quickly realizes that much more is at stake than bragging rights!

videos.title: Front Man
videos.overview: Neal helps an old friend whose daughter has been kidnapped, without realizing that it's all a trap from an old enemy.

videos.title: Out of the Box
videos.overview: Neal and Alex attempt to recover a music box from the Italian Consulate. Peter and Diana try to take down Fowler

videos.title: Withdrawal
videos.overview: Peter and Neal try to stay a step ahead of a sophisticated bank robber. But once alarms are set off throughout the city, the guys realize they're dealing with a true professional.

videos.title: Need to Know
videos.overview: Neal goes undercover as a political "fixer" in order to bring down a corrupt politician. Diana and Peter's lead brings them to an unidentified man who escapes their pursuit. It is also revealed that Peter had Diana keep the music box's location hidden even from Peter himself. Neal begins to suspect that Peter is investigating the plane explosion behind his back.

videos.title: Copycat Caffrey
videos.overview: Peter sends Neal back to school after someone copycats one of his old schemes. Alex returns with some bad news. Diana discovers the music box is hiding something. Peter and Diana set out to find the missing key, which is the last piece of the music box that Alex gives Neal before leaving for Italy. Aidan Quinn guest stars as a criminology professor.

videos.title: By the Book
videos.overview: When Mozzie believes someone he cares about has been kidnapped, he turns to Peter and Neal for help.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: In order to save the life of an insurance investigator named Sara Ellis, Neal and Peter have to find out why a real-estate mogul put a price on her head.

videos.title: In the Red
videos.overview: The arrest of a jewel thief leads Peter and Neal toward a much more heinous extortion case against adoptive parents.

videos.title: Prisoner's Dilemma
videos.overview: An FBI Agent is accused of selling witness locations during criminal trials, and the U.S. Marshals ask Peter and Neal for help tracking down the suspect. But when Peter uncovers the truth behind the plot, he must dive into the world of exotic cars and go on the run with his fellow agent until he can prove the man's innocence.

videos.title: Company Man
videos.overview: Neal and Peter must go undercover into the world of corporate espionage after a tech company's head researcher is murdered.

videos.title: Point Blank
videos.overview: Neal orchestrates an elaborate con to bring himself face to face with Kate's murderer.

videos.title: Burke's Seven
videos.overview: Mozzie narrowly escapes death and Neal uses his contacts to help Peter find Mozzie's shooter Julian Larssen. However, Larssen manages to blame Peter instead and is released. Suspended from the FBI, Peter enlists the help of Neal, Jones, Diana, Sara, Mozzie and even Elizabeth to run a sting to finally catch Larssen and to clear his name.

videos.title: Forging Bonds
videos.overview: Peter goes back to the time he arrested Neal for the first time. In the meantime, Neal remembers meeting Kate and Mozzie.

videos.title: What Happens in Burma
videos.overview: Peter and Neal work to free a diplomat's son, who has been taken into custody in Burma for a crime he didn't commit. The case requires the duo to use diplomatic laws to their advantage in order to overcome the obstacles facing them.

videos.title: Countermeasures
videos.overview: Neal is suspicious when an old friend of June's husband is released from jail and shows up for a visit.

videos.title: Payback
videos.overview: Matthew Keller, Neal's imprisoned rival, contacts Neal and Peter to make a deal. However, the two have to realize Keller set them up to kidnap Peter and to force Neal to bargain with Jason Lang, Keller's former partner turned adversary.

videos.title: Power Play
videos.overview: Peter and Neal assume each other's identities to uncover a collusion scheme.

videos.title: Under the Radar
videos.overview: Neal gets closer to finding out the truth about Kate's death.

videos.title: On Guard
videos.overview: Despite their newly-arisen trust issues, Neal and Peter have to work together to catch a thief who took his stash out of the Federal Reserve.

videos.title: Where There's a Will
videos.overview: Peter and Neal find a treasure map on a forged will, and soon enter a race to locate the treasure and save the daughter of the beneficiary.

videos.title: Deadline
videos.overview: Diana goes undercover to protect a magazine journalist; Peter and Neal investigate a pharmaceutical company.

videos.title: The Dentist of Detroit
videos.overview: Peter and Neal help Mozzie rework a scam to prevent a mob war.

videos.title: Veiled Threat
videos.overview: Peter and Neal pose as wealthy bachelors to catch a black widow.

videos.title: Scott Free
videos.overview: A teenage con man goes on a New York crime spree.

videos.title: Taking Account
videos.overview: When an expert hacker drains a prominent New York bank, Neal assumes the criminal's identity in order to spend the pilfered fortune and draw him out of hiding.

videos.title: As You Were
videos.overview: When an old Naval Academy buddy of Agent Jones goes missing, Peter and Neal delve into the dangerous world of international private security to find him.

videos.title: On the Fence
videos.overview: Neal goes undercover in an attempt to capture a wanted fugitive; Keller confesses his motive for returning to New York.

videos.title: Countdown
videos.overview: Neal and Mozzie must stay ahead of the FBI when one of the treasure's paintings is flagged.

videos.title: Checkmate
videos.overview: Elizabeth's kidnapping forces Neal to come clean to Peter about his betrayal.

videos.title: Upper West Side Story
videos.overview: Neal poses as a substitute teacher to investigate missing scholarship funds.

videos.title: Neighborhood Watch
videos.overview: When Elizabeth overhears one of her neighbors in a suspicious conversation, her curiosity leads Peter and Neal to uncover a robbery plot against a posh Manhattan Hotel.

videos.title: Pulling Strings
videos.overview: Sparks fly when Neal teams up with his ex Sara to track down a missing Stradivarius. The mission offers Neal a glimpse into a different kind of life for himself.

videos.title: Stealing Home
videos.overview: Neal joins the crew of a wealthy Yankees fan, tasked with stealing memorabilia from Yankee Stadium.

videos.title: Judgment Day
videos.overview: Agent Kramer wants to derail Neal's commutation; Neal tries to right a wrong from his past; Peter is forced to choose sides.

videos.title: Wanted
videos.overview: Peter tries to find Neal on a remote island before a bounty hunter locates him first.

videos.title: Most Wanted
videos.overview: Peter comes up with a strategy to return Neal to the U.S. before Collins catches him.

videos.title: Diminishing Returns
videos.overview: The guys track a brilliant thief who's eluded the FBI for years.

videos.title: Parting Shots
videos.overview: The team investigates a widow on the verge of an inheritance.

videos.title: Honor Among Thieves
videos.overview: A female art thief makes Neal an offer in exchange for important information.

videos.title: Identity Crisis
videos.overview: Mozzie, Neal and Peter follow clues left in a storage unit.

videos.title: Compromising Positions
videos.overview: A criminal with a vendetta against Peter hires a political fixer to sabotage the trial.

videos.title: Ancient History
videos.overview: The team investigates a series of museum heists that target rare artifacts.

videos.title: Gloves Off
videos.overview: Neal goes under cover as a stock trader on Wall Street.

videos.title: Vested Interest
videos.overview: Peter and Neal pursue one of the paintings on the treasure manifest.

videos.title: Family Business
videos.overview: Peter and Neal attempt to find the truth behind Neal's father's crime. In doing so, Neal must go undercover into the world of counterfeit whiskey to take down a high-level member of the Irish Mob.

videos.title: Brass Tacks
videos.overview: Peter and Neal look into Senator Pratt's ties to corrupt cops who framed Neal's father and tore his family apart. Their investigation leads them to a real-estate developer running a kickback scheme.

videos.title: Empire City
videos.overview: Peter and Neal work a forgery and money laundering case that leads them into two of the most iconic New York institutions, taxi cabs and jazz.

videos.title: Shoot the Moon
videos.overview: Peter and Neal work from different angles as they attempt to stop a thieving duo bent on going out in a hail of bullets rather than watch their whirlwind relationship fade away behind bars.

videos.title: The Original
videos.overview: Peter and Neal get closer to finding out the mystery behind Ellen's evidence box while simultaneously chiseling their way through the world of sculpture forgery.

videos.title: In the Wind
videos.overview: Peter and Neal are one heist away from retrieving the evidence box hidden inside the Empire State Building. Meanwhile, Senator Pratt has enlisted a small army of FBI agents to find the box before Neal.

videos.title: At What Price
videos.overview: With Peter in prison facing murder charges and every shred of evidence pointing to him for Senator Pratt's untimely death, Neal must strike a deal with the devil to help try and clear Peter's name.

videos.title: Out of the Frying Pan
videos.overview: Peter assigns Neal a new handler to investigate an online black market, but Neal's loyalties will be tested when he discovers the trail might lead to Mozzie.

videos.title: One Last Stakeout
videos.overview: As Peter settles into a promoted position at the FBI, Neal has to pull off a brazen museum heist right underneath the FBI's nose.

videos.title: Controlling Interest
videos.overview: Peter sends Neal undercover with a psychiatrist who may be manipulating her patients into committing robberies.

videos.title: Master Plan
videos.overview: Neal must go undercover as a butler to expose an imposter who aims to inherit a Manhattan family's fortune.

videos.title: Ice Breaker
videos.overview: Peter and Neal must go undercover as ice skating pros to expose a counterfeit passport ring in Little Odessa.

videos.title: Quantico Closure
videos.overview: While Neal delves further into the mystery of the Codex, Peter takes on a classified espionage case with a fellow FBI agent: his ex-girlfriend.

videos.title: Digging Deeper
videos.overview: Neal and Peter take on an unprecedented asset recovery case for the Museum of Natural History: a stolen Tyrannosaurus Rex skeleton and its egg.

videos.title: No Good Deed
videos.overview: Peter's thrown back into an unsolved larceny case that has Neal worried – because Neal's the one who committed the crime.

videos.title: Live Feed
videos.overview: A life hangs in the balance after Hagen tasks Neal with his final assignment.

videos.title: Shot Through the Heart
videos.overview: When Neal and Peter go after an assassin, the stakes are raised even higher when they realize this may be the same person who has been pulling Neal's strings.

videos.title: Taking Stock
videos.overview: When a corporate espionage case has personal ties to Neal, Peter recruits Diana from maternity leave for an undercover sting on a rogue stock trader.

videos.title: Diamond Exchange
videos.overview: Neal and Peter race against a criminal mastermind to unearth an invaluable treasure hidden in New York.

videos.title: Borrowed Time
videos.overview: Peter brings in Rebecca to help locate Neal who's been held captive, by someone she used to work with.

videos.title: Return to Sender
videos.overview: Neal must work with an enemy from his past to be able to help the Pink Panther.

videos.title: Uncontrolled Variables
videos.overview: Neal is conflicted over scamming an innocent mark. Peter is working with an Interpol agent who could ruin their operation.

videos.title: All's Fair
videos.overview: Peter and Neal focus on a case dealing with someone from Mozzie's past.

videos.title: Whack a Mole
videos.overview: Neal must orchestrate a treacherous operation for the Pink Panthers on short notice.

videos.title: Au Revoir
videos.overview: In order to help Neal carry out a risky heist, Peter must involve himself in a dangerous con.
